notes: Deliberately narrow. Serum creatinine is ordered as a single test, and a report containing only creatinine is complete - not a failed extraction.
eGFR is optional because it is calculated from creatinine, age and sex rather than measured, and only some labs print it. Apollo Diagnostics reports creatinine together with eGFR; many labs do not.

The wider kidney panel - urea, BUN, uric acid, sodium, potassium, chloride - belongs in a separate RENAL_PROFILE template. Folding it in here would report every standalone creatinine report as missing six analytes.
This panel is the canonical example of why matching cannot be string equality: the same test arrives as Creatinine Serum, S. CREATININE, Sr.Creat and CREATININE(SERUM).
